headline: Bahlil to make new rules for subsidized fuel purchases! To prevent long queues at gas stations (SPBU)
summary: Indonesia's Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia said the government is formulating new rules for purchases of subsidized fuel. The aim is to prevent long queues at gas stations.
why: Subsidized fuel policy affects state budget spending and retail fuel supply in Indonesia. Changes to purchase rules can alter fuel demand and the cost of government subsidies.
